newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Airlines July load factor falls.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Airlines July load factor falls.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Wednesday its July load factor fell to 74.4 percent from 74.6 percent in the same month a year ago.

July traffic decreased 13.5 percent from a year ago to 2.52 billion revenue passenger miles, reflecting a planned downsizing of aircraft on some international routes, TWA said in a news release. Available seat miles were off 3.38 billion.
For the year to date, TWA's load factor rose to 69.6 percent from 68.2 percent in the same period a year ago.
Traffic for the year-to-date fell 7.7 percent from last year to 14.57 billion revenue passenger miles. Available seat miles were off 9.6 percent to 20.94 billion.
Shares of TWA were trading up 1/16 to 7-3/16.
